365:t_5:102.en:
$$桂$$
「Ha ha... You stole my signature line.」

365:t_5:103.en:
$$桂$$
(But, $$ミムジィ$$... I think that someday I have to atone for what I did in the past.)

365:t_5:104.en:
$$桂$$
(The people who were made unhappy by the birth of the multiverse won't forgive me for existing.)

365:t_5:105.en:
$$桂$$
(So when that day comes, I intend to do what I can, even if it costs me my life...)

365:t_10:5.en:
$n
「...I'll make up for my mistake with my own hands. And to do that...」

365:t_10:6.en:
$n
(I have to surpass who I've been up to now... the weakling I used to be...)

365:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Who would have thought it would come to this... Now all my calculations have to be redone...)

365:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(On top of that, without Miss $$スズネ$$, neither the $$ジェニオン$$ nor the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ can give 100% of its power...)

365:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...AG Quote No. 36! Don't think about what there's no point thinking about!」

365:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, naturally, the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open 24 hours a day, all year round.」

365:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Out of consideration for $n, who's down over there, I'll put off the congratulations for our ace pilots until next time, though.」

365:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's go all out again today and tomorrow... business, business!」

365:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Also, the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will be selling antique mobile suits excavated from $$マウンテンサイクル$$.」

365:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「They're bargains you can't get anywhere else, so don't miss out!」

366:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「We've entered combat range of the $$ターミナル・ベース$$ where the target is being held.」

366:t_000:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Commence the attack. Don't forget that it's only meant to hold them in check.」

366:t_001:0.en:
$$ラム$$
「Message from Major $$コンロイ$$! He reports that they've broken into the base facility!」

366:t_001:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「So phase one of the operation is a success.」

366:t_001:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The enemy's interception force is coming out!」

366:t_002:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn you, $c...! Could it be that you know about the one in this base?!」

366:t_002:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「...Never mind. They make perfect prey for me, banished to a dead-end post, to stage my comeback.」

366:t_002:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll bury them here and return to the front lines once more!」

366:t_002:3.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The enemy commander appears to be $$ギルター・ベローネ$$.」

366:t_002:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「In that case, the bad feeling $$セツコ$$ had really was about that guy...!」

366:t_002:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... That man is here too...」

366:t_002:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Rescuing $$オルソン$$ comes first. Until the assault team returns, this ship will draw the enemy's attention alone.」

366:t_003:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Good... We've done our duty as a diversion. This ship is withdrawing.」

366:t_004:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Did you think you could bring down the base with a single ship, without even deploying mobile units...!」

366:t_004:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I won't let you escape! All forces, pursue!」

366:t_006:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What about $$セツコ$$...!? And everyone on the assault team!?」

366:t_006:3.en:
$n
「I hear $$桂$$ found $$オルソン$$. $$セツコ$$ has joined up with the assault team and is escaping.」

366:t_006:4.en:
$n
「We'll buy them time! Can you do it!?」

366:t_006:6.en:
$n
(Good... It doesn't look like she was affected by $$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア・アクト$$.)

366:t_006:7.en:
$n
(Was it cancelled out by the power of $$セツコ$$'s $$スフィア$$...?)

366:t_006:8.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Those $$いがみ合う双子$$...! When did they get all the way over there!」

366:t_006:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Still, coming with only a single unit is as good as coming here to die.」

366:t_006:10.en:
$n
「Quit the chatter and come at me, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$, the self-proclaimed mastermind.」

366:t_006:11.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Insolent! I'll butcher you in front of $$バルビエル$$!」

366:t_006:12.en:
$n
「I said spare me the big talk and hurry up and come. If you can't hear me, I'll come to you!」

366:t_006:14.en:
$$スズネ$$
(What is this... My head... hurts...)

366:t_007:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I can't keep piling up blunders in front of $$バルビエル$$...!」

366:t_008:0.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! The $$クォーター$$ is here!」

366:t_009:1.en:
$n
「Nothing to worry about on my end. Is everyone on the assault team safe?」

366:t_009:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All that's left is for $$桂$$ to escape.」

366:t_009:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$モーム$$ is on her way to pick him up.」

366:t_009:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Let's clear out the pests so we can bring $$桂$$ back!」

366:t_009:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But first, a big shot is making an appearance.」

366:t_010:1.en:
$n
「Quite the drawn-out entrance. Or were you shocked that we got away from you?」

366:t_010:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So my poison really doesn't work on you all...」

366:t_010:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We've already broken through $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s $$スフィア・アクト$$ too!」

366:t_010:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$スフィア$$ power that acts on the human mind... But if you keep a strong heart, you can resist it!」

366:t_010:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「$n and $$セツコ$$ proved it for us!」

366:t_010:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You really are fools. To be so conceited as to think you broke my poison on your own.」

366:t_010:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Well, no matter. It's a fact that the poison had no effect on you.」

366:t_010:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The relief of knowing your friends have come leaves an opening in the heart... And my poison slips into it...」

366:t_011:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you doing, $n! $$バルビエル$$ is coming!」

366:t_011:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Farewell, $n. Before long, I'll take the $$ジェニオン$$ back.」

366:t_012:1.en:
$$シン$$
「What's going on!? That's no human movement!」

366:t_012:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's better this way for you too.」

366:t_012:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You seem to understand your position.」

366:t_012:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Then let's go, $$アムブリエル$$.」
